defensiveAbilities.name: Fall Apart
defensiveAbilities.description: When one of the Guests dies, its body falls apart into a tangle of meat, gristle, fur, bone, and gore. All creatures within a 10ft Emanation (other than other Guests) must make a DC 22 Will Saving Throw save to avoid becoming Sickened 2 (Sickened 4 on a critical failure) at the sight and smell of this fate.

offensiveAbilities.name: Frozen Wind
offensiveAbilities.description: The guest exhales a blast of freezing wind from its body in a 20ft Cone. All creatures in this area take 8d6 Cold Damage (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw). The Guest can't use Frozen Wind again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Stunning Critical
offensiveAbilities.description: If a Guest critically hits a creature with a claw Strike, the target must make a DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Stunned 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Trigger Memory
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A gatewalker attempts to Strike a Guest or target a Guest with a spell

Effect The first time a gatewalker (including any PC) attempts to Strike a Guest or target it with a spell, a repressed memory from their Missing Moment surfaces. For a brief instant, the character recalls facing down a much larger and fully formed saumen kar, one with four horns and glowing runes on its fur. This memory of the character's first encounter with Ainamuuren evokes waves of fear and shame. The character must make a successful DC 25 Will Saving Throw save or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure), after which the character is immune to Trigger Memory.
